# Lab Submission Instructions

QuickFeed provides a canonical, course-aware submission guide in its web interface.
Students can open their course page and select **Submission Guide** under **Help**.

Teaching staff should refer students to that guide instead of copying the general QuickFeed workflow into course repositories.
This keeps instructions about repositories, synchronization, submissions, and slip days aligned with the deployed QuickFeed version.

## Course-Specific Additions

Course documentation should only describe requirements that are specific to the course, such as:

- deadlines and extensions;
- whether and when group work is allowed;
- required commit-message conventions for manual review;
- approval and resubmission policies; and
- whom students should contact for course support.

Course-specific rules supplement the in-app guide and take precedence when they intentionally differ from its general workflow.
